sources.quote: V424 Lacertae, also named Tengshe, is a red supergiant and a variable star in the constellation Lacerta.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 7,747 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,724 K, so 211.738 solar radii.
